reason: A is better because it assigns thermal-expansion mismatch to actual nanoscale regions or precipitates, links measurable residual strain to dislocation resistance, and proposes correlated mechanical, thermoelastic, and microstructural tests with a clear falsification criterion. B incorrectly treats elements within a solid solution as independently expanding constituents and predicts that reducing pinning residual stresses would lower creep rate, contradicting its own mechanism.
